# `company.list_merge_references`

Editable references an account or item merge re-pointed to the survivor, kept so an undo puts each back.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this re-pointed reference. |
| `merge_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with merge_id + position | — | list_merges.id | The merge that re-pointed it. |
| `position` | INTEGER | no | — | unique with merge_id + position | — | — | Order the merge wrote it in; undo puts them back in reverse. |
| `table_name` | VARCHAR(64) | no | — | — | — | — | Table of the editable list row that named the merged entry. |
| `record_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | That row. |
| `column_name` | VARCHAR(64) | no | — | — | — | — | Its column that named the merged entry. |
| `action` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | repoint: the column now names the survivor; end: the row was made inactive because the survivor already has its own. |
| `before_value` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | — | What the column held before the merge (the merged entry). |
| `after_value` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | — | What the merge wrote (the survivor), or null for an ended row. |
| `owner_kind` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | List record the row belongs to, whose version the merge advanced. |
| `owner_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | That record. |
